candidate_increment: Decision-reliable approximation for source-consistent paid material repair/expansion/verification; task/compute evidence required beyond classical Bayes planning.
current_permission_scope: Metadata/task contract and independent mathematics only. Any new material fit requires actual-time protocol, source/input pins and root approval.
prerequisites: Freeze original-formula/run/source/state grouping before response access; no old consumed cohorts re-split.
A new warm/dev cohort may establish feasibility but is not independent confirmation.
State computational versus wet experimental provenance; preserve target units and field derivations.
Fit all transforms only on fit rows; do not use diagnostic or future target labels for kernel, sign, feature or prior selection.
Specify covariance/mean assumptions, proper NIW parameterization, finite predictive first moments, full latent dimension and uncertainty retained.
Compare full posterior, plugin Gaussian and independent marginals under identical visible0/1/2proxy information.
Do not transfer previous common-marginal correlation-moment certificates to general unknown-mu/Sigma likelihoods.
report_before_new_campaign: Native-unit target CRPS and prediction interval diagnostics; no cross-target aggregate without frozen physical scaling/weights.
Model inadequacy versus arithmetic/posterior approximation error distinguished.
Observed co-measurement overlap and posterior relation sensitivity; overlap graph connectivity not equated with identification.
Warm/dev only admission decision plus explicit stop/failure, no testset optimization.
later_task_contract_must_define: All legal old-row missing-native-cell actions, new-row proxy actions and paid direct-target actions available to every relevant baseline.
Hard budget and any bundle setup/sample/probe costs; offline artificial costs labelled assumptions, not measured wet savings.
Verified-target objective distinct from inferred target completion; no pseudolabel feedback into observations.
Every observed failure/error retained; known duplicated/derived quantities not counted as independent evidence.
Same information posterior and full conditional branches for full-joint versus approximation comparisons.
Pre-fixed action-disagreement/error tolerance/rejection criterion and compute budget; no true-model certificate from ensemble spread alone.
go_no_go: Conditional go to one baseline-adequacy gate only; no-go to new multiagent/model-stack campaign until task and model passes.
